verse: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
verse_spoken: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength;
they shall mount up with wings as eagles;
they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
prayer: Heavenly Father, I come to you today tired, and I need your strength.
You see the weight I carry and the battles no one else can see.
When I feel weak, remind me that your power is made perfect in weakness.
Renew my body, refresh my mind, and lift my weary spirit.
Give me strength for every task in front of me today.
Teach me to wait on you instead of running on my own effort.
Help me rise above discouragement like an eagle on the wind.
Let me run and not grow weary, walk and not give up.
Strengthen everyone praying with me today, and carry us when we cannot stand.
